title: asset-gen style tooling per project: init, derive, bump, report and the asset-style skill
goal: Give each game project a guided way to create, structure, version and tune its art style, instead of hand-run style-lock steps. Core styles stay untouched; structure lives in the project's own game style.

tasks.objective: Add assetgen.py style init --id <id> --extends <core style> [--family <family>=<style id>] --authoring <A>. It writes a draft game style (extends the core style, version 1, status draft) and a valid assetgen/project.json skeleton. The logic lives in a new scripts/assetgen/style_cmd.py with a thin hookup in assetgen.py. It never overwrites an existing file and never edits core data.
acceptance: style init creates the draft style and project.json; lint passes with 0 FAIL and the expected WARN for missing structured fields
an existing style or project.json is never overwritten (exit 1 with a message)
no file under templates/assetgen/ changes

tasks.objective: Add assetgen.py style derive --authoring <A> --style <id> [--family F] [--apply]. From the valid active anchors it deterministically proposes structured fields: palette colours (with text), tone tolerance and canvas aspect per family. Output is a proposal; --apply merges it only into a style whose status is draft and never into an active style. Fix the mismatch where stylelock.style_errors rejects a canvas entry that has only min_side while consistency.canvas_config accepts it. Logic in a new scripts/assetgen/style_derive.py.
acceptance: same anchors give byte-identical proposals (no clock, no randomness)
--apply refuses an active style and a style without anchors
after --apply on a draft style with anchors the style-palette, style-tone and style-canvas QA rows are available instead of NOT_AVAILABLE
a canvas entry with only min_side is accepted by lint

tasks.objective: Add assetgen.py style bump --authoring <A> --id <style>: create version N+1 as a draft copy, update nothing that is active, and list the anchors, runs and rejections that need re-approval for the new version. Where the previous anchors can be re-proposed under the new version they are written only as proposed and never activated. Run the quality plugin on the result: if it rejects carried anchors, limit the verb to listing and say so.
acceptance: style bump never edits an active version in place and never sets an anchor to active
the report names every anchor, run and rejection that needs re-approval
the artifact-quality check for the assetgen domain shows no new FAIL on the bumped authoring fixture

tasks.objective: Add the read-only assetgen.py style report --authoring <A> [--style S] [--json]: per style and family, the palette and tone spread over the approved runs, the WARN and FAIL rate of each style-* QA row, rejections by reason, and suggested thresholds (max_distance, tolerance) with the data behind each. Deterministic and read-only; add it to the read-only verbs of /rpg-factory:assetgen. Logic in a new scripts/assetgen/style_report.py.
acceptance: style report writes nothing and exits 0
suggested thresholds are only printed with their supporting numbers, never applied
/rpg-factory:assetgen accepts style report as a read-only verb and still refuses the write verbs

tasks.objective: Scaffold the new tech skill: python3 -B scripts/new-skill.py --name asset-style --kind tech --repos authoring --domain assetgen --used-by asset-gen --summary <one line>. It writes skills/asset-style/SKILL.md and the registry fragment and rebuilds registry.json. Then update every touchpoint scripts/skill-touchpoints.py names: skills/factory-core/SKILL.md, skills/factory-core/references/skill-contract.md layering diagram, README.md diagram and tech table, docs/architecture/overview.md tech-skill count, and name rpg-factory:asset-style in skills/asset-gen/SKILL.md. Replace every SCAFFOLD marker with real, minimal but valid content (the current style-lock facts, citing docs by section), because verify runs skills-lint on the candidate and a marker fails it. The content task expands it later. Registry changes are a global input of tests/affected.py: expect every suite in verify.
acceptance: asset-style is registered as a tech skill with used_by asset-gen and paths assetgen/; it is not in the module skills list and is never a lead
registry.json equals the build of the fragments (build-registry --check)
README, factory-core, skill-contract and overview name the skill and their counts match the registry
asset-gen/SKILL.md names rpg-factory:asset-style and stays at most 160 lines
no SCAFFOLD marker remains and skills-lint passes on the candidate

tasks.objective: Write the content of the asset-style skill and move the style-lock reference into it. Workflow: art-bible-first bootstrap (camera, palette, lighting, proportions, material rules, negative prompts), 6-12 reference images from a rights-clean set, exploration runs, a person picks, anchors and rejections, then style init, derive, bump and report. The description must make asset-gen load it for a style-only request, since tech skills are never routed on their own. Remove style-lock.md from asset-gen, point to asset-style, and free lines in asset-gen/SKILL.md. Cite code by anchor symbol and docs by section.
acceptance: no SCAFFOLD marker remains; SKILL.md is at most 160 lines with at most 3 references
skill-citations passes for the skill (python3 -B scripts/checks/skill-citations.py --skill asset-style)
agents are never told to activate an anchor or approve a run; those stay human gates
asset-gen/SKILL.md no longer links the moved reference and stays at most 160 lines

tasks.objective: Add the routing scenario for asset-style in tests/routing.test.sh (the lead and tech expectations next to the existing asset-gen scenario), a dogfood scenario with PROMPT and EXPECT in tests/dogfood.sh that includes asset-style, and the eval grader evals/asset-gen-icon/graders/asset-style-fired.md in the same format as comfyui-fired.md.
acceptance: routing.test.sh covers asset-style as a tech skill under asset-gen and passes
skill-touchpoints.py asset-style prints OK
the grader file matches the pattern of the existing -fired graders

tasks.objective: Human-gated and removable: allow an anchor from existing art (art bible, hand-made image) that has no gen-run. promote-anchor gets --external <png> --origin <text> --rights-note <text> and writes a proposed anchor with an external-source record (image sha256, origin, rights note, attested_by) instead of source_run. Only a person activates it and the person is the attester; an agent-attested or unattested external anchor fails the gen-run-style check. Update the anchor schema, stylelock.run_ref_errors and the quality plugin rule that requires an approved source gen-run. Anchors from gen-runs keep working exactly as before.
acceptance: an external anchor is written as proposed with approved_by null and never as active
an active external anchor attested by claude, codex, gpt* or SAME_MODEL:* fails gen-run-style
gen-run anchors, selection and drift behave as before (existing tests unchanged)
the record carries no file path outside the authoring repo and no credential

tasks.objective: Document the style tooling: the domain doc Style lock and Bootstrap sections, scripts/README.md command list. Add a backlog item to docs/plans/backlog.md: bump the six core styles to structured v2 after a project has real derived values, with the reason that it changes every core style hash and drifts old runs.
tasks.grade_reason: documentation only; the behaviour is tested in the earlier tasks
acceptance: the domain doc names style init, derive, bump, report and the external anchor with its human gate
backlog.md carries the core-style bump item with its reason
no machine-specific absolute path appears under docs/plans/
